title: LiSA: Lifelong Safety Adaptation via Conservative Policy Induction
first_author_affiliation: Google Cloud AI Research / Seoul National University
code_status: 固定v1正文与Google官方详情未找到公开作者实现；明确未核实已开源
summary: 固定基础guardrail，从稀疏失败报告归纳广义策略并保留混合标签的局部边界；用Beta后验下界只门控广义记忆，按余弦平均链接跨日重聚类，避免弱证据过早影响安全决策。
fidelity_note: CPU执行真实Beta分位数、average-linkage余弦聚类/代表原句、标签支持矛盾汇总、按领域混合案例的局部提示、两通道检索上限及原句存活统计继承。LLM策略草稿和语义embedding由显式外层提供；本地合成输入不是最终guardrail/安全能力，heldout组拒绝进入适应；没有API模型或Evolve晋级。

cost_assessment.available_resource: one NVIDIA A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.model_scale: Gemini3.1flash-lite/ClaudeHaiku4.5 online, Gemini3.1pro offline manager, Geminiembedding001 managed API
cost_assessment.data_scale: three public benchmark streams;5–10days, daily heldout evaluation,5seeds,noise and ablations
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: many managed inference/embedding/induction calls across the full matrix; paper does not provide a safe short single-device runtime; no trial launched
cost_assessment.decision: 完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；只做CPU数学与有界记忆流程，不发API或下载checkpoint

local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.agent_research.lisa import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(seed=42))'
